---
title: Visualizing a graph
---

`to_mermaid()` and `to_dot()` render a `SyntaxGraph` as plain text -- no extra dependency needed -- ready to paste into a Mermaid- or Graphviz-aware viewer:

```python
graph = SyntaxGraph.from_doc(doc)

print(graph.to_mermaid())                  # "graph BT" ... (root-at-top tree)
print(graph.to_mermaid(orientation="LR"))  # left-to-right instead

print(graph.to_dot())                      # a Graphviz "digraph { ... }"
```

`to_mermaid`'s `orientation` accepts Mermaid's flowchart directions: `"TB"`, `"TD"`, `"BT"` (the default), `"RL"`, or `"LR"`. Both functions escape token text so that quotes, pipes, and backslashes in the underlying words don't break the diagram syntax.
